tmvec.head: tmvec1-large
tmvec.description: Structural similarity, the default: cosine of two rows is a predicted TM-score. TM-Vec head trained on SWISS-MODEL pairs through 1000 residues.

tmvec-300.head: tmvec1
tmvec-300.description: The same TM-score head trained only through 300 residues; for in-range sensitivity analyses against `tmvec`.

esm2-8m.head: generic
esm2-8m.description: General sequence features (homology, family), not calibrated to structure. 8M parameters: quick tests and smoke runs, weak structural signal.

esm2-150m.head: generic
esm2-150m.description: General sequence features at mid scale; a compromise when esm2-650m is too heavy for the device.

esm2-650m.head: generic
esm2-650m.description: General sequence features (homology, family, function-adjacent) when structural similarity is not the question; distances are not calibrated to any named quantity.
